name: Fluke Education Discount Program
summary: Apprentices and RTO students get a yearly discount code for Fluke electrical test tools from the Fluke Australia online store.
key: 25% off select Fluke tools, kits and accessories, once per calendar year.
who: Current apprentices and students enrolled at registered training organisations
how: Submit the application form with proof of apprenticeship or enrolment; Fluke emails a discount code within about 48 hours.
catches: One tool or kit plus up to one accessory per year.

evidence.quote: Current apprentices and students currently enrolled at valid registered training organisations are eligible
